title: Time spent in primary activities and percent of the civilian population engaging in each activity, averages per day by sex
universe: Civilian noninstitutional population age 15 and over
limits: A day's total for people who volunteered that day, not the length of one session; national only. Read through the fetch tool; a plain download from the cloud returns Access Denied.
use: volunteerHours: one volunteering act for a cause is one participant-day, 2.18 hours; the spread is women's 2.16 to men's 2.20. The 5.3% engaged on a day is a band the year run reports, never a chance anyone reads.
